scope: Frontend distinction between measured PowerX resources, current environment database and all-content disk-volume usage. Not full PowerX accounting or live host acceptance.

source_verification.filesystem: HistoryPoint.used_bytes and available_bytes copy the sampled Filesystem fields; the scope is the Core-visible disk volume, including other applications and personal files, not PowerX ownership.
source_verification.database: HistoryPoint.database_bytes copies the currently connected database size. postgres_metrics_repo.go reads pg_catalog.pg_database_size(current_database()); this excludes file logs, media, backups and separate plugin databases.
source_verification.no_complete_total: Overview.coverage is partial. Neither the entire disk nor the current database is a complete PowerX total. No disk-minus-database subtraction is attributed to PowerX.

implemented: Overview defaults to measured PowerX data: current environment database and registered non-shared directories, with total explicitly not fully measured.
Whole-disk cards and registered shared sources have a separate scope selection. Unclassified disk usage is explicitly not attributed to PowerX.
History navigation renamed Usage history. Default table contains only timestamp and current environment database; whole-disk table contains only timestamp, all-content disk used and available space.
Removed mixed Total usage column, long blue technical notice and duplicate physical/deduplicated directory columns; sampling details expand on demand while errors and scope changes remain visible.
History dates follow selected UI locale. Four languages use explicit measurement scope labels.
Scope switches preserve history selection and directory filter context, reuse the same loaded observations and add no polling. Identity change still aborts and resets prior data.
Usage guide, UI design and canonical specs progress clarify current behavior and remaining accounting coverage.
